text:
Alex: Hey team — vendor just updated the manifest, looks like the H100 rack that was marked for our PO has a different serial range than our reservation. Can someone check reserved pool mapping and quota impact?
Priya: Which PO number? I can start tracing allocations in Terraform state.
Alex: PO 2026-0923-RWF. Vendor's note: delivered serials 8D3A-8D9F instead of 8C10-8C6F.
Sam: Pulling GCP quota now. If the serials are different but same SKU we might still be able to assign to our dedicated pool, but need vendor confirmation for rack binding.
Lin: If those serials map to a different rack/zone we could hit affinity constraints in our Dedicated pools and break the strict isolation rule for that tenant. Need to know zone labels.
VendorOps: Sorry about the mismatch — manual receipt error at the warehouse. Serial batch 8D3A-8D9F is actually reserved for partner account 'BeaconAI' but we can swap next-day if you approve. ETA for swap: 36h.
Alex: 36h is rough for next week's demo. What's the immediate quota consequence if we keep these in place and just reassign in infra?
Sam: Short answer: we can remap at the control plane if the GPUs are in the same region and computeSKU matches. Two caveats: (1) live tenants with strict rack pinning will be impacted, (2) firmware/drivers need to match our preflight image.
Priya: I'll diff the Terraform state for the cluster. If it's just a label mismatch we can patch tags and leave billing unaffected. If the rack ID is different we need a mini-migration.
Lin: Can we fall back to hosted for the demo traffic? Route low-priority demo jobs to hosted for 48h while we swap.
Alex: Good idea — keep the customer-facing demo green. Who owns the routing change?
Sam: I can open a short-lived route policy in the console, point demo route -> hosted pool, TTL 48h, and monitor latency. Need an approval from infra lead.
Priya: On migration plan: if we need to migrate VMs, we'll schedule a quiesce window of 30m and do live cache flush. That's doable overnight.
VendorOps: If you opt for swap, we can prioritize a carrier pickup tonight and target arrival in your DC by tomorrow midday. We'll cover expedited handling.
Alex: Can you confirm the DC and zone? We need a formal ETA with zone to validate quota.
VendorOps: Pickup tonight is outbound to us-east1-c (your reserved zone). ETA 12:30 UTC tomorrow.
infra-bot: Deploy bot: triggered canary route update by Sam at 17:20 UTC — status: scheduled.
Sam: Pushed the route policy to staging, canary scheduled for 17:20 UTC. I'll keep an eye on qps and p95.
Priya: Terraform note: PO 2026-0923-RWF references resource ids (dedicated_pool.rwf-a100[0..7]) — if vendor swaps racks, I will update mappings and open a PR for an infra-safe rebind.
Lin: For risk: add a short-term fallback to dedicated-fallback-pool with relaxed pinning so we don't block tenant ops.
Alex: Action items: (1) Sam to run canary at 17:20 and report p95, (2) Priya to prepare TF PR to rebind if swap happens, (3) VendorOps to confirm pickup + tracking, (4) Lin to create fallback pool. Everyone ack?
Sam: Ack. I'll post metrics link after canary.
Priya: Ack — working on the PR now.
Lin: Ack — creating fallback pool and will tag it as 'ephemeral-demo-fallback'.
VendorOps: Acknowledged — I'll DM tracking info and follow up when pickup is scanned. Apologies for the mixup.
Alex: Thanks. If swap slips past tomorrow midday we proceed with hosted fallback and migration overnight. Keep updates in this thread pls. :thumbsup:
